description:
## Goal
Retain the exact reads of a failed compiler derivation in the existing scheduler dependency owner, so unchanged input does not retry failed compiler work and relevant dependency movement reawakens the producer exactly once. This is a prerequisite of removing standing-wait scans in fz-kdt.46.

## Evidence
On fz-tfn/long-lived-recalculator, base ad0ac47d3, the parked .46 scope-aware frontier candidate exposes failed_macro_product_remains_demanded_after_retirement_and_source_repair. The first macro lowering reports lower/unbound for Missing.value/0. After retiring its retained product session and replacing the macro source with quote 40 + 2, the request must return 42 and recreate RootBackendProduct generation1. Instead it stalls on Settled(RootEntry(root3)); exact standing prerequisites include Current(LoweredBody(Function31)), StaticCallees, InputDemand and Recursive. Logs: /tmp/fz-kdt46-macro-diagnostic.log, /tmp/fz-kdt46-macro-waits.log, /tmp/fz-kdt46-macro-ground-oracle.log. A temporary test-only comparison against the former upstream support predicate matched throughout; it was removed. This is not an established external-witness mismatch.

jobs/body.rs::lower_function records FunctionDefined(function) and other reads locally, then collect_local_*? and lowerer.lower()? can return FatalError before JobEffects carries those reads into Scheduler. Drive error paths exit without completion/subscription. The initial failed producer therefore has no precise read edge to wake on source repair. The old unresolved inventory scan masked this by redemanding the missing producer. Direct existing-API RED on the blocker base independently proves this attribution: /tmp/fz-tfn46-failed-reads-red.log fails because the actual failed LowerFunction retains no FunctionDefined read.

## Strategy
Follow .agent/strategies/output-contract-loop.md. Establish failure as a typed outcome at the existing job/derivation ownership boundary. Preserve attempted exact reads and valid prior claim/finality semantics when evaluation fails; retain diagnostics with correct source provenance. No parallel failed-job registry, replay queue, per-request rescanner, unconditional retry, invented empty-read conclusion, or job-to-job enqueue authority. Trace all normal/product/nested drive paths and existing error contracts before choosing the minimal coherent model. Audit other fatal job paths for the same loss; do not patch only LowerFunction while leaving the shared contract contradictory.

## TDD and acceptance
- An initially failing producer retains exactly the reads actually observed before failure; no fabricated downstream reads or output claims.
- Repeating an unchanged failed request does no producer evaluation; an unrelated edit does not retry it. Relevant read movement wakes it once, repair succeeds, and another unchanged request reuses the result.
- Pin the real failed macro retirement/source-repair scenario, diagnostics and generation1 restoration. Narrow the existing Capture event borrow around inspection so it cannot hide retry diagnostics.
- Preserve failed native/backend product retry, nested active roots, reconciliation-only demand scope, ordinary blocked/concluding derivations, retraction and ground-shift finality. Explicitly define what happens to previous successful claims after a failed re-evaluation and prove consumers cannot observe stale success.
- One World fact authority and one ProductMemo artifact authority; failure dependency state lives at the existing dependency owner. No display strings or incidental ordering as semantic authority.
- Deterministic causal work counts and same-version artifacts. Target fixtures through interp/run/build, full library, serial matrix, CLI/cross-process checks, docs and strict clippy/fmt; fresh ticket-scoped cold review before one commit/close.
- Remove all temporary probes, A/B/oracle paths and scaffolding. Update fact-engine/pipeline/error-contract documentation from final code.

## Execution boundary
Root will preserve the uncommitted .46 candidate separately, implement this prerequisite on the current branch head, then restore/revalidate .46. Do not edit the historical parked worktree or blindly apply prior experiments. Root owns staging/commit/close/push; implementation agent owns Cargo until explicitly released. Push only after the preceding exact pushed head CI succeeds. No deferral of this failure-ownership contract is authorized.


## Recoverable branch boundary
Root selectively stashed exactly the kdt.46-owned 18 tracked and 2 untracked files in commit69e41a8d2cf2681ca65b3b76c0fc29bbe6a666d1 (message: fz-kdt.46 scope-aware edge candidate parked for fz-tfn.46 failure ownership). All unrelated untracked measurements remain in place; working source is clean at ad0ac47d3. Do not drop this stash. Restore by explicit immutable stash commit only after separately reviewed fz-tfn.46 lands, resolve overlaps with its final owner model, and revalidate all kdt.46 gates. Agent implement_tfn46_failure owns the blocker source/build workflow; implement_kdt46_edges is released and available for resumption. Root owns restoration/index/commits/push.

## Final implementation model
Jobs and both drive families retain the exclusive Result<JobEffects,FatalError> through completion. Compiler-owned failure.rs carries attempted fact/product reads plus immutable Rc-owned diagnostics. Each local read owner enriches the error before unwinding, including scope/expansion sessions, dispatch, source definition, type resolution, semantic analysis, and lowering. Absence prerequisites already examined become reads on failure. Diagnostic emitters preserve their original payload; existing silent internal failures remain silent. Frozen lexical namespaces remain frozen.

DependencyIndex's existing per-job roster record owns only FailureDiagnostic, with no second failed-read or failed-job registry. Attempted dependencies move into ordinary subscriptions. Failure withdraws old output claims and all owned World contributions; activation contributions use explicit conclude_exact(empty), bypassing successful cumulative frontier preservation. Queued repair hides the previous error; pop clears it before nested work runs. A failed retry replaces it, and successful completion clears it. An exact nonempty count gates terminal failure inventory; successful drains visit zero roster records.

Terminal product attribution follows only the requested dependency's blockers. Missing facts use the fact-to-producer map's exact waits; present unsettled facts use their actual publishers. Scheduler projects only those publishers' pending finality reads into settled questions, so Current(product) with an existing generation but unquiet validation still blocks Settled(parent), while Current(parent), quiet absent reads, satisfied shared facts, and sibling derivations do not. ProductSessions supplies exact retained product snapshots. Traversal never enqueues or evaluates work. Retained diagnostics replay without copying their strings/spans or allocating another retained payload.

## TDD evidence and checks
- Direct lost-read RED: /tmp/fz-tfn46-failed-reads-red.log runs1/fails1, empty reads versus exact FunctionDefined; corresponding GREEN /tmp/fz-tfn46-failed-reads-green.log.
- Retained request replay: /tmp/fz-tfn46-replay.log GREEN1. Three requests retain original lower/unbound diagnostic/source provenance; producer count1 across unchanged/unrelated source, healthy root7, exact repaired source42 at count2, then unchanged reuse.
- Real World withdrawal RED: /tmp/fz-tfn46-withdrawal.log caught incorrect preservation of the failed analysis contribution. Explicit exact withdrawal passes in /tmp/fz-tfn46-world.log, World36/36; surviving publisher row remains, stale exclusive fact vanishes, exact attempted reads replace old reads.
- Stale artifact proof: /tmp/fz-tfn46-stale-success.log GREEN1, initial41, failed replacement errors repeatedly with LoweredBody withdrawn, repair42.
- Nested macro retirement/repair and unchanged failed macro lowering count are preserved; /tmp/fz-tfn46-macro.log GREEN3 and full library passes enhanced regression.
- Scheduler lifecycle/nonempty-inventory controls GREEN58 in /tmp/fz-tfn46-scheduler.log; final-source sibling-derivation/current-content control is included in final library.
- Finality-only attribution RED /tmp/fz-tfn46-finality-red.log proves retained generation1/unquiet Current(product) initially hid original failure from Settled(parent). /tmp/fz-tfn46-finality-green.log GREEN1 after exact owner finality projection; Current(parent) remains available and diagnostic lookup starts zero jobs.
- Earlier broad gates: full library1903 pass/0 fail/6 existing ignored; serial matrix537/0; CLI30/0 plus AOT test; strict all-target/all-feature clippy clean.
- Final-source full library1905 pass/0 fail/6 existing ignored (/tmp/fz-tfn46-lib-final.log), CLI30/0 plus AOT1/0 (/tmp/fz-tfn46-cli-final.log), and strict all-target/all-feature clippy (/tmp/fz-tfn46-clippy-final.log) are clean. Formatting and git diff --check are clean. Final-source serial matrix537/0 is GREEN in /tmp/fz-tfn46-matrix-final.log; fresh cold review remains required before commit/close.
- Root independent immutable-binary proof GREEN: /tmp/fz-tfn46-after.QwdhTf covers all3 target fixtures through interp and native, all exit0 with exact goldens. Backend and CLIF artifacts are byte-identical to /tmp/fz-tfn24-after.n6luYj. Exact per-job-family completions and per-product-family evaluated/settled counts match both doors: jobs1393/2394/4233 and RuntimeDemand body243/589/1280 unchanged.
- Root staged only the39 owned paths and started fresh cold_tfn46_failure review at staged diff SHA256 d79d1f34fa2da0fefe1d21f56b190947704604933a7071024c76292697fd9e2c. Cold review found further exact-owner gaps; provisional freeze is lifted for the scoped corrections below.

## Provisional freeze
Exact39 owned paths: /tmp/fz-tfn46-owned-files.txt. Immutable final-source debug compiler /tmp/fz-tfn46-candidate.1UXF3b/fz2 SHA256 fb72151c69b6a1b28a07416adf4bcb23f5f266ab241825af134c7e278dabaded. No temporary production probes, old-path oracle, or retry registry remains. Root owns review, artifact comparisons, staging, commit, close, push and PR; implementation retains Cargo until final handles terminate.


## Cold-review corrections in progress
First cold review did not approve: DefineModule late interface validation omitted the observed ModuleIndexed source; accumulated struct validation dropped earlier successful StructDefined consultations before a later error. Module exact-read RED /tmp/fz-tfn46-module-red.log and GREEN /tmp/fz-tfn46-module-green.log; one observed-source owning helper now captures ModuleIndexed across all scoped-definition error exits. Struct walk RED /tmp/fz-tfn46-struct-red.log and GREEN /tmp/fz-tfn46-struct-green.log cover both specs and separate type declarations: actual field consultations retain A and B, while fieldless Unused is not fabricated as a schema read. A borrowed read accumulator transfers into normal success/failure ownership.
Additional cold checks are unresolved: prior successful AnalyzeActivation return payload may outlive withdrawn ReturnType and be rejoined on repair; a real qualified Check.checked source fixture is under diagnosis and is not yet accepted as target RED. A fresh unrelated root after a retained failed macro is confirmed RED /tmp/fz-tfn46-healthy-macro.log: global pending product-request drain surfaces unrelated root3 failure instead of healthy7. Root is coordinating whether this existing global-request path is an independent prerequisite; no demand-dropping or error-swallowing fix is authorized. All findings must be resolved or explicitly ticketed and authorized before final review/close. Previous frozen binary and broad gates predate these corrections.
title: Preserve exact dependency ownership across failed compiler derivations
